title: Mediocre and SO MESSY!!
text: Mediocre and SO MESSY!!. I really, really wanted to love this burr grinder. It looks sleek and modern. It’s heavy and truly seemed liked the real deal. There are a few flaws though that made me pack it up and put it away. First, there is no hopper to store beans in. The company touts this as a bonus but, after using it, I don’t think it is. The bean lid is magnetic so it fits on there fine but it’s a pain to pour your beans in there daily. They can spill and it’s an unnecessary step every morning pre-coffee. Second, the static caused by the grinder is dreadfully horrific. No matter how careful I am there are grounds EVERYWHERE. EVERYWHERE!! You can’t escape it. Soooooo messy. The little rubber top comes off the top of the grounds cup when you pour the freshly ground coffee into your maker too. MORE MESS! Lastly, the grinder stops mid-grind once in a while. Meaning, PRE COFFEE, I have to pull it out, disassemble it, clean it then start over. It’s too much. Especially when I’ve used the same little krupsGrinder everyday for a decade with zero mess and no mid-grind halt. For the money, this thing should be FLAWLESS. It’s not. And it’s not worth the hassle.
